resources.string: The Morabaraba Collection is a tribute to the cultural heritage of Africa. Our mission is to preserve and digitalize traditional strategy games that have been played for centuries across the continent. From the strategic depths of Morabaraba to the quick chases of Rabbit vs. Dogs, we bring these timeless classics to the palm of your hand.
To create an immersive digital experience that honors the traditional roots of African board games while introducing them to a global audience through modern mobile technology.
I am a passionate developer and cultural enthusiasts dedicated to bringing tradition into the digital age. My work focuses on accuracy, performance, and delivering a fun experience for all ages.
Special thanks to the communities that keep these games alive and to all our beta testers who helped refine the gameplay experience.

Privacy Policy

 This privacy policy applies to the Morabaraba Collection app (hereby referred to as "Application") for mobile devices that was created by MasiloDev (hereby referred to as "Service Provider") as a Free service. This service is intended for use "AS IS".

 Information Collection and Use

 The Application itself does not require or support user account creation, and it does not directly collect personally identifiable information such as your name, email address, or phone number within the app.

 However, the Application uses Google AdMob, which automatically collects certain information to facilitate advertising. This information is processed according to AdMob’s Privacy Policy and is used to provide personalized ads, measure ad performance, and prevent fraud.

 Automatically Collected Information includes:

 • Device Identifiers: Such as your IP address and the Google Advertising ID (AAID).

 • Approximate Location: Derived from your IP address to provide relevant local advertisements.

 • App Activity: Information on how you interact with the Application, such as the time spent in the app and which ads are displayed or clicked.

 • Device Information: Your mobile device's operating system version and model.

 The Application does not gather precise GPS location information.

 Third-Party Access

 Only aggregated, anonymized data is periodically transmitted to external services to aid the Service Provider in improving the Application. The Application utilizes third-party services that have their own Privacy Policies regarding data handling.

 Third-Party Service Providers used by the Application:

 • Google AdMob / Google Play Services

 Disclosure of Information

 The Service Provider may disclose Automatically Collected Information:

 • As required by law, such as to comply with a subpoena or similar legal process.

 • When they believe in good faith that disclosure is necessary to protect their rights, protect your safety or the safety of others, or investigate fraud.

 • With trusted service providers (like AdMob) who work on their behalf and have agreed to adhere to strict data protection rules.

 Opt-Out Rights

 You can stop all collection of information by the Application easily by uninstalling it. You may use the standard uninstall processes available as part of your mobile device or via the mobile application marketplace. You can also reset your Advertising ID or opt-out of personalized ads in your Android device settings.

 Data Retention Policy & Account Deletion

 Because the Application does not allow users to create accounts, there is no "User Provided" account data to maintain or delete. If you contact the Service Provider via email for support, your email address will be retained only for as long as necessary to resolve your inquiry.

 Children

 The Service Provider does not use the Application to knowingly solicit data from or market to children under the age of 13. The Application is not intended for individuals under 13 years of age. If a parent or guardian becomes aware that a child has provided information via communication (like email), please contact kopanangmasilo71@gmail.com so the Service Provider can take necessary actions.

 GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation)

 Users in the European Economic Area (EEA) have rights regarding personal data processed by AdMob. This includes the right to access, correct, or request deletion of identifiers used for advertising. For more information, please visit AdMob GDPR Information.

 Security

 The Service Provider is committed to safeguarding the confidentiality of your information and provides physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards to protect the data processed by the Application.

 Changes

 This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. The Service Provider will notify you of any changes by updating this page. Continued use of the Application is deemed approval of all changes.

 Effective Date: 2026-04-30

 Contact Us

 If you have any questions regarding privacy while using the Application, please contact the Service Provider via email at kopanangmasilo71@gmail.com.

Welcome to the most comprehensive guide for the Morabaraba Collection. Whether you are a beginner or a seasoned strategist, this guide will help you master every game in our collection. Learn the rules, discover secret strategies, and dominate the board!

Morabaraba is an ancient and deeply tactical game. Each player starts with 12 pieces, known as "cows".

 Phase 1: The Placement (Placing Cows)
 The board is empty. Players take turns placing one cow on any unoccupied junction (where lines meet). Your goal here is to set up "Mills" while blocking your opponent from doing the same.

 Phase 2: The Battle (Moving Cows)
 After all 24 cows are placed, the movement phase begins. You can move a cow from its current junction to any adjacent empty junction connected by a line. Strategic positioning is key to trapping your opponent.

 Phase 3: The Flight (Desperation Mode)
 When you lose cows and are down to exactly 3, your cows gain the ability to "fly". You can move a cow to any empty junction on the board, regardless of lines. This makes a losing player very dangerous!

 Mills and The "Shoot" Rule:
 A "Mill" is a row of three cows of the same color. When you form a Mill, you get to "shoot" one of your opponent's cows off the board. Rule of Honor: You cannot shoot a cow that is part of an opponent's Mill unless ALL their cows are in Mills.

 Victory Conditions:
 1. Reduce your opponent to 2 cows (they can no longer form a Mill).
 2. Block your opponent so they have no legal moves left.

 Strategy Tip: Try to build a "Double Mill" where moving one cow back and forth forms a new Mill every turn!

This is a game of uneven odds. One player is the elusive Rabbit, and the other controls a pack of hungry Dogs.

 The Dogs' Mission:
 You control several dogs. Your only goal is to corner the Rabbit so it cannot move. Remember: Dogs can only move forward or sideways along the lines—they can never retreat! You must work as a team to close the net.

 The Rabbit's Mission:
 You are faster and more agile. You can move forward, backward, or sideways. Your goal is to break through the line of dogs. Once you get behind them, they cannot turn around to catch you, and you win.

 Winning the Game:
 - Dogs Win: If the Rabbit is completely surrounded and has no empty adjacent spots to jump to.
 - Rabbit Wins: If it crosses to the other side of the board or bypasses all dogs.

 Strategy Tip: Dogs should stay in a tight line to avoid leaving "holes" for the Rabbit to slip through.

Alquerque is the grandfather of modern Checkers. It is a game of pure aggression and calculated sacrifices. Movement: Pieces are placed on the junctions. You can move a piece to any adjacent empty junction along the lines. Unlike Checkers, you can move in any direction from the start. The Capture (The Jump): To capture, you must jump over an opponent\'s piece into an empty spot directly behind it. The captured piece is removed. Chain Reactions: If you land and can immediately jump another piece, you must continue jumping until no more captures are possible. Victory: The first player to capture all 12 of their opponent\'s pieces wins. If the game reaches a stalemate where no one can move, it is a draw. Strategy Tip: Control the center of the board. A piece in the center has more options for both attack and defense.

Local Play: Simply pass the phone back and forth or sit opposite each other.

 Game Controls:
 - Pause: Stop the timer and hide the board.
 - Resume: Jump back into the action.
 - Surrender/Quit: End the current match if you find yourself in a hopeless position.
